mapper.select: WITH periods AS ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(e.created_at, '%Y-%m') AS period FROM employee e WHERE 1 = 1 AND 1 = 1 AND e.department_id = #{departmentId} AND e.id = #{employeeId} AND 1 = 0 AND e.created_at >= #{from} AND e.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at, '%Y-%m') FROM hr_request r JOIN employee e ON e.id = r.employee_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND 1 = 1 AND e.department_id = #{departmentId} AND e.id = #{employeeId} AND 1 = 0 AND r.created_at >= #{from} AND r.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(b.created_at, '%Y-%m') FROM ocr_binding b JOIN archive_version v ON v.id = b.archive_version_id JOIN archive_document d ON d.id = v.document_id JOIN employee e ON e.id = d.employee_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND 1 = 1 AND e.department_id = #{departmentId} AND e.id = #{employeeId} AND 1 = 0 AND b.created_at >= #{from} AND b.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ), employees AS ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(e.created_at, '%Y-%m') AS period, COUNT(*) AS count_value FROM employee e WHERE 1 = 1 AND 1 = 1AND e.department_id = #{departmentId}AND e.id = #{employeeId}AND 1 = 0 AND e.created_at >= #{from}AND e.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(e.created_at, '%Y-%m') ), workflows AS ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at, '%Y-%m') AS period, COUNT(*) AS count_value FROM hr_request r JOIN employee e ON e.id = r.employee_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND 1 = 1AND e.department_id = #{departmentId}AND e.id = #{employeeId}AND 1 = 0 AND r.created_at >= #{from}AND r.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at, '%Y-%m') ), ocr AS ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(b.created_at, '%Y-%m') AS period, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succeeded_count, SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_count FROM ocr_binding b JOIN archive_version v ON v.id = b.archive_version_id JOIN archive_document d ON d.id = v.document_id JOIN employee e ON e.id = d.employee_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND 1 = 1AND e.department_id = #{departmentId}AND e.id = #{employeeId}AND 1 = 0 AND b.created_at >= #{from}AND b.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(b.created_at, '%Y-%m') ) SELECT p.period, COALESCE(e.count_value, 0) AS employee_count, COALESCE(w.count_value, 0) AS workflow_count, COALESCE(o.succeeded_count, 0) AS ocr_succeeded_count, COALESCE(o.failed_count, 0) AS ocr_failed_count FROM periods p LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.period = p.period LEFT JOIN workflows w ON w.period = p.period LEFT JOIN ocr o ON o.period = p.period ORDER BY p.period

SELECT d.id AS department_id, d.name AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) AS employee_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ea.id) AS archive_count, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS workflow_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.status LIKE 'PENDING%' THEN r.id END) AS pending_workflow_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.status = 'ABNORMAL' THEN a.id END) AS abnormal_access_count FROM org_department d LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN employee_archive ea ON ea.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN hr_request r ON r.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN archive_access_application a ON a.department_id = d.id WHERE d.enabled = TRUE AND 1 = 1 AND d.id = #{departmentId} AND e.id = #{employeeId} AND 1 = 0 AND (e.created_at IS NULL OR e.created_at >= #{from}) AND (e.created_at IS NULL OR e.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) GROUP BY d.id, d.name ORDER BY employee_count DESC, d.sort_order, d.id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_count, COALESCE(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, r.created_at, r.completed_at)) / 3600, 0) AS average_duration_hours, COALESCE(MIN(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, r.created_at, r.completed_at)) / 3600, 0) AS shortest_duration_hours, COALESCE(MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, r.created_at, r.completed_at)) / 3600, 0) AS longest_duration_hours FROM hr_request r JOIN employee e ON e.id = r.employee_id WHERE r.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND 1 = 1 AND e.department_id = #{departmentId} AND e.id = #{employeeId} AND 1 = 0 AND r.created_at >= #{from} AND r.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
